prompt.project_info: Ultra-photorealistic 8K cinematic-reality gym mirror portrait adapted from the source prompt and folder context.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm tungsten overhead gym lighting creates specular highlights on sweat and hair; intense raw fitness-focused candid mood.
prompt.technical_specs: DSLR-style 85mm portrait lens, f/2.8, sharp face and clothing detail, creamy equipment bokeh, realistic skin and mirror reflection, photorealistic 8K finish.
